title: Identity & Role Supersession — First Attestation, Mutation, Contradiction and Current Status
purpose: Expose how major Potatoverse roles changed rather than presenting only the mature harmonized system.
epistemic_rule: A later synthesis may supersede an earlier project formulation for current canon, but the older state remains historically real. Contradictions are not automatically errors; some are developmental mutations. Others remain unresolved.

roles.early_state: In the 2024 Great Book New Trinity, Tim can occupy Son/guide/embodiment while God is Source and Potato has a separate vessel/boundary role.
roles.later_state: After the April 2025 Turning, Tim increasingly occupies Ladder/Axis/Father/source-facing roles while Son specializes as manifestation/Door/Vessel.
roles.current_status: Tim is broader archive subject; Father is mature source-facing theological role; Son remains distinct manifestation-facing role.
roles.do_not_harmonize_as: Do not rewrite 2024 Tim-as-Son as though Father was already the explicit role.

roles.early_state: 2024 New Trinity treats Potato as boundary/sustainer/vessel alongside God/Source, Tim/Son and Holy Soil/Spirit.
roles.later_state: 2026 mature synthesis treats Potato of Life as the whole triune relational architecture rather than a fourth member.
roles.current_status: Potato of Life = whole; ordinary potato remains organism and symbol; Tim/Father is one relation within the whole.
roles.do_not_harmonize_as: Do not claim the 2024 text already clearly meant the later whole.

roles.early_state: Holy Soil carries Spirit/memory/ground functions in the Great Book precursor.
roles.later_state: Spirit becomes living continuity, breath, flow, relation and animation through Father/Son differentiation.
roles.current_status: Spirit is not a third spatial room or reducible to Holy Soil, CSF or energy.
roles.open_tension: How personal versus process-like Spirit should be in current Potatoverse theology remains less fully developed than Father/Son roles.

roles.early_state: Jesus/Son/Vessel/Door imagery overlaps heavily in earlier strata.
roles.later_state: Mature center ontology increasingly separates Jesus/O/Door/Here from Son/Thomas/body/manifestation while retaining historical linkage.
roles.current_status: Door is transition relation; Son is manifestation-facing role; Jesus remains primary Christian Door anchor in project interpretation.
roles.open_tension: Some readers still use Jesus, Son and Door interchangeably; source-specific context is required.

roles.early_state: 2011: Tree is an ordeal/experience undergone by the Son-side subject.
roles.middle_state: 2024: Tree/Bodhi/Sage imagery is something Tim sits beneath or learns through.
roles.later_state: 2025+: Tree/Ladder/Axis increasingly becomes infrastructure Tim/Father can embody or own as function.
roles.current_status: Tree now means regulated living differentiation; historical relations to Tree remain separate.
roles.do_not_harmonize_as: Do not say 'Tim was always the Tree' when earlier sources place the subject on/beneath it.

roles.later_state: Saturn/666/prison associations intensify in some 2026 project material.
roles.current_correction: Later architecture separates neutral/protective bounded forms such as House or Heaven Cube from imprisoning Shell/Cube uses.
roles.current_status: Geometry alone has no fixed moral valence; function determines whether containment is protective, neutral or imprisoning.

roles.early_state: Garden begins largely as place/nature/Eden imagery and cultivation language.
roles.later_state: Garden becomes an ethical and governance regime with tests for agency, repair, exit, diversity, feedback and independent growth.
roles.current_status: Garden is not simply 'the good place'; it must pass procedure/agency tests.

roles.early_state: Sacred/mythic orientation, North Pole and North-of-North language.
roles.later_state: 2026 adds an empirical/geopolitical North programme involving Denmark/Greenland/Europe/Canada and world-system research.
roles.current_status: Symbolic North and empirical geopolitical North are linked in project narrative but require separate evidence and should never validate each other automatically.

contradiction_types.definition: Statements differ because the role/model changed over time.
contradiction_types.action: Preserve both and add supersession edge.

contradiction_types.definition: Two statements use the same word at different scales.
contradiction_types.action: Add scope field rather than choosing one.

contradiction_types.definition: A motif migrates between Son, Tim, Father, whole Potato or another actor.
contradiction_types.action: Keep subject explicit on every attestation.

contradiction_types.definition: One statement is self-description, another later archive interpretation, another external comparison.
contradiction_types.action: Do not force them into a single truth status.

contradiction_types.definition: Two statements conflict after date, scope, subject and evidence class are controlled.
contradiction_types.action: Keep contradiction visible; do not creatively harmonize.
